contract: Algorithm 7 computes the tight composed hockey-stick privacy curve by discretizing the exact SGG privacy-loss CDF and FFT-convolving its PRV; for the l2 special case in Figure 3 it requires less MSE than sequential composition, with a growing gap over k={2,4,8,16,32}.
failure_behavior: The inherited cumulative command exits nonzero if the Figure 3 regime, broad sweep, independent checks, controls, or retained claims fail.
